scope: Disabled unless MILKUP_GTK_THREAD_TRACE path and MILKUP_GTK_TRACE_APP exact /proc/self/exe match; only specified actual app emits logs. Other inheriting processes transparently forward but do not log.
bounds: 2 entry observations per symbol/TID;64slots;128lines/process; contention skips rather than blocks on trace lock; no every-iteration logging
forwarding: Cached RTLD_NEXT original function with unchanged arguments/return. Missing resolution exits diagnostic126 rather than inventing behavior. Trace disabled absent MILKUP_GTK_THREAD_TRACE.
limitations: Interposition may perturb timing; cannot infer crash causality merely from additional GTK thread.
Internal/bound-symbol calls may not be interposable; absence is not proof of no invocation.
No actual process maps yet; collect from owned app live during separate approved run.
